fields.description: Checklist version this step belongs to, e.g. 1.7. Written from the parent criterion on save; never edited on its own.
fields.label: Checklist Version

fields.description: Criterion this step belongs to within the checklist version, e.g. CC-01.
fields.label: Criterion ID

fields.description: Stable machine key for this step within the criterion, e.g. intake, test_plan, gaps_closed.
fields.label: Step Key

fields.description: Vendor-facing label for this validation step, e.g. Gap register reviewed.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Display order for this step; lower numbers appear first.
fields.label: Sort Order

fields.description: The checklist status this step belongs to. A status can only be marked complete once every step of that status is complete.
fields.label: Checklist Status

fields.description: A note/evidence citation is mandatory when this step is completed directly (no sub steps).
fields.label: Requires Note

fields.description: Guidance shown to the vendor while they work this step.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Evidence required when the step is completed directly. Once the step has sub steps, each sub step carries its own evidence rule.
fields.label: Evidence

fields.description: The step cannot be completed without the configured evidence.
fields.label: Evidence Required

fields.description: Note = text citation, File = uploaded file, Note or file = either one.
fields.label: Evidence Type

fields.description: Hint shown to the vendor, e.g. Link to the gap register export.
fields.label: Evidence Hint
